products.name: Legendary Collection Booster Box
products.note: 36 packs plus one of four oversize reverse-holo box toppers (S1 Charizard, S2 Dark Blastoise, S3 Dark Raichu, S4 Mewtwo; the toppers are not simulated). TCGplayer lists the box (691155) with no price and no sales, so it is priced at 36 packs.
